QuestInfo.name: [White Heaven] What's Karula Up To?
QuestInfo.0: Find Karula in Orbis and ask about the ship in the skies of Orbis.
QuestInfo.1: Karula totally just dropped that she did indeed build the ship that's menacing Orbis! Tell Kayla that she was right.
QuestInfo.2: Kayla the Fairy said that someone needs to board White Heaven and check it out. She totally had that 'I mean you' look on her face, too.
